title: Land still to be possessed
english: [[Much land remains — Philistines and regions >> Bible:Joshua 13:1-6]]. Jesus is old; contests remain. In the church vice-nations still await storming.
translator_notes: Copy-text Baehrens GCS 30 / Origenes Werke VII (1921), Rufinus Latin.
True OET: no ANF; do not copy Bruce FOTC 105 (Joshua).

title: Levi’s portion is the Lord
english: [[To Levi he gave no inheritance; the Lord is his inheritance >> Bible:Joshua 13:14]]. Priesthood seeks not estates but the Lord.
translator_notes: Copy-text Baehrens GCS 30 / Origenes Werke VII (1921), Rufinus Latin.
True OET: no ANF; do not copy Bruce FOTC 105 (Joshua).

title: East-Jordan allotments recalled
english: Reuben, Gad, and Manasseh’s lots are recalled. Those who already received must help their brothers. Amen.
translator_notes: Copy-text Baehrens GCS 30 / Origenes Werke VII (1921), Rufinus Latin.
